components.name: button
components.title: Button
components.scope: Default variant only; see native manifest and tests. No new test result claimed by this map.

components.name: checkbox
components.title: Checkbox
components.scope: Checkbox root only; checked/unchecked × normal/hover/focus/disabled × scales 1–3. Mixed state is a web composition without native pixel proof. Edge/DPR 1.

components.name: slider
components.title: Slider
components.scope: 225 explicit horizontal single-thumb cases. Range, RTL, inverted and vertical have web behavior tests; no native pixel guarantee for those extensions.

components.name: input
components.title: Input
components.scope: 306 explicit ASCII text-input cases at integer scales 1–3, including caret/selection/scrolling. Password, Unicode, RTL and specialized types use browser rendering; their pixels are not native-verified.
